To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

a system that uses a combination of statistical NLP and reasoning methods can outperform a purely statistical NLP system on the Facebook bAbl dataset, that a reasoning module can be used to improve the performance of a purely statistical NPL system and that the performance of the system can be significantly improved by using a translation system.
the combination of inductive rule learning and reasoning with statistical NLP methods improves the performance of the system in answering questions in the Facebook's bAbl challenge.
In summary, our research is concerned with
developing a system capable of solving the tasks proposed by the Facebook's bAbl challenge, which is an open-ended question-answering challenge.
the development of an intelligent agent capable of learning to perform a wide range of tasks.
a novel approach to the development of an agent that can solve a set of question answering tasks.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the introduction of reasoning and knowledge representation in the form of logic programming significantly improved the performance of an agent on the tasks proposed in the Facebook bAbl challenge.
the proposed system is a step in the direction of creating a system that can learn and solve a set of challenging question answering tasks.
the proposed agent, which combines statistical methods with Inductive Rule learning and Reasoning, outperforms the current state of the art in all but one of the tasks.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the combination of statistical NLP methods with a reasoning system, such as ASP, can be very useful in solving challenging tasks, especially when there is a need for a large amount of knowledge.
we propose a system that can learn from a small amount of training data to answer questions about a domain by combining statistical methods with a reasoning system.
we have shown the importance of combining the statistical and the logical methods in solving the question answering tasks.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a combination of statistical NLP models and a reasoning module can be very successful in solving a wide range of question answering tasks.
the combination of statistical methods with reasoning can be a promising approach in solving challenging tasks.
the introduction of reasoning in the agent's model allows it to learn the necessary knowledge from the data, which is crucial to solving a variety of tasks.
